title: Çekip Giderdin
author: Ahmet Erol
description: This is the story of two lovers from a mysterious past: Melih and Tülay. As we go on a nostalgic journey through the love letters they once exchanged, a detailed portrait of a lifetime gradually unfolds. Ahmet Erol traces the fragile border between love and loss, desire and absence. Through a lyrical and deeply emotional narrative, the novel portrays the aching solitude of being abandoned and the haunting persistence of memory. The characters grapple with betrayal, longing, and the human need to hold on—even when faced with the inevitability of separation. With a voice both poetic and piercing, Erol captures the intensity of passion and the silence it leaves behind.
